clue.text: Accidental accommodation for two families sharing

a dwelling divided between, or shared by, two households

explanation.surface: Someone finds a home shared by two families quite by chance.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a musical sign lowering a note a whole tone, and a twin-household apartment.

clue.text: Harbour in which a captured pirate may find himself

definitions.meaning: the enclosure for the accused in a courtroom

clue.text: Above cutting off the top part of a coupon

indicators.text: cutting off the top part of

explanation.definitionFit: Upon and above both mean on top of or over.

explanation.surface: The songs of a famous leader.

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Conforming means toeing the line, obeying rules like a soldier in rank.

explanation.definitionFit: The reckoning subject of the three Rs is number work.

clue.text: Production of Carmen needing a lightertouch

clue.text: Fly over 150 on the next page

clue.text: Russian fighter captures north China

clue.text: Surprised because one thought of the chap only as a batsman?

clue.text: Apparently the merchandise is not moving at all

clue.text: Married, but not same parent

clue.text: Unattractive as an investment

clue.text: Want to reside here there and everywhere

explanation.surface: Someone longs to live in many places at once.

clue.text: Create new version of old card game

clue.text: What I have to finish the salad

clue.text: A man of remarkable self interest

definitions.text: A man of remarkable self interest

parts.words: A man of remarkable self interest
parts.note: describes a person wholly absorbed in himself
